name: Sourdough Biscuits
instructions: Night before: Grate cold butter into large bowl. Add flour, cut butter in until pea-sized crumbles.
Add starter discard, buttermilk, and sugar. Stir until combined. Cover, rise on counter 10–12 hours.
Combine salt, baking soda, and baking powder in a small bowl. Work into dough in two halves.
Flour work surface. Press dough into 1-inch thick rectangle.
Cut with biscuit cutter — press straight down, do NOT twist.
Arrange in 12" cast iron skillet. Bake 25–30 minutes until tops are golden.
notes: Do not twist the biscuit cutter — seals edges. Active starter can substitute discard: add salt to initial mix, omit baking soda/powder, let rise in skillet 60–90 min before baking. Prep 10 min / Ferment 12 hr / Cook 30 min.
